description: Unsaved changes: nothing is closed, and the next step is to save first (the project has no file yet).

error.detail: the project has unsaved changes; discardUnsaved true quits anyway and loses them

nextStep.message: The project was never saved, so it has no file and no copy can be written. Ask the user whether to save it (opentune_save_project, mode save_as, an absolute .otproj path, for example next to the vocal file) or to throw the unsaved changes away; do neither without an answer. After a save, call opentune_quit again. Only if the user explicitly agrees to throw the unsaved changes away, call opentune_quit again with discard_unsaved: true.
